ApplyAutoCluster.description_en: Applies the clustering suggestions for a specified analysis batch. Only partitioned tables are supported. Before calling this operation, you can call GetAutoClusterSuggestion to view the recommended configurations and table modification SQL statements. This operation returns a response after the table modification is successfully executed
ApplyAutoCluster.description_zh: 应用指定分析批次的聚簇建议。仅支持分区表。调用前可用 GetAutoClusterSuggestion 查看推荐配置和表变更 SQL。接口在表变更执行成功后返回

CancelAgentChat.description_en: Stops the ongoing agent generation in a specified conversation and clears pending confirmation operations
CancelAgentChat.description_zh: 停止指定会话中正在进行的Agent生成，并清理待处理的确认操作

ChatSse.description_en: Exposes the public entry point for the MaxAgent service

CreateMmsDataSource.description_en: Creates a data source for data migration from the data source to MaxCompute by using MMA
CreateMmsDataSource.description_zh: 创建数据源，通过MMA将数据源的数据迁移到MaxCompute

CreateMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_en: Pulls the metadata of a data source
CreateMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_zh: “拉取数据源元数据”任务会将数据源的元数据拉取出来

CreateMmsTimer.description_en: Creates a scheduled task for data migration
CreateMmsTimer.description_zh: 创建数据迁移定时任务

CreateQuota.description_en: Creates a quota. When you activate MaxCompute for the first time, you must first create a pay-as-you-go quota. If you create a subscription quota, fees are automatically deducted
CreateQuota.description_zh: 创建Quota，首次开通MaxCompute 必须先创建后付费类型的Quota，如果创建的是预付费类型的Quota，会进行自动扣款

CreateRole.description_en: Creates a project-level role in MaxCompute

DeleteComputeQuotaPlan.description_en: Deletes a MaxCompute compute quota plan

DeleteMmsDataSource.description_en: Deletes an MMA data source, including its migration plans and metadata
DeleteMmsDataSource.description_zh: 删除MMA数据源，包括数据源的迁移计划、元数据

DeleteMmsJob.description_en: Deletes an MMA data migration plan

DeleteProject.description_en: Deletes a MaxCompute project. This operation is irreversible. Use caution when calling this API
DeleteProject.description_zh: 删除MaxCompute项目。此操作不可逆，请谨慎调用此API

DeleteRole.description_en: Deletes a project-level role in MaxCompute

GetAutoClusterEstimatedUtility.description_en: Queries the estimated benefits of automatic clustering for the current tenant in the current region, summarizing the number of benefiting jobs and the estimated amount of Shuffle data that can be saved, grouped by analysis batch
GetAutoClusterEstimatedUtility.description_zh: 查询当前租户在当前地域的自动聚簇预估收益，按分析批次汇总可受益的作业数和预计可节省的 Shuffle 数据量

GetAutoClusterEstimatedUtilityByProject.description_en: Queries the number of optimizable jobs and the estimated amount of shuffle data that can be saved for a project in a specified analysis batch. You can filter the results by schema and table
GetAutoClusterEstimatedUtilityByProject.description_zh: 查询项目在指定分析批次中可优化的作业数和预估可节省的 Shuffle 数据量。可按 Schema 和表过滤

GetAutoClusterInfo.description_en: Queries the current clustering configuration and actual benefits of a table, including the number of benefited jobs, saved CU hours, and shuffle data volume. Returns the current configuration of the table even if no benefit records exist
GetAutoClusterInfo.description_zh: 查询表的当前聚簇配置和实际收益，包括受益作业数量、节省的 CU 时和 Shuffle 数据量。无收益记录时仍可返回表的当前配置

GetAutoClusterSuggestion.description_en: Queries the current clustering configuration, recommended configuration, and estimated shuffle benefits for a specified table. If a recommendation is available, the corresponding ALTER TABLE SQL statement is also returned
GetAutoClusterSuggestion.description_zh: 查询指定表的当前聚簇配置、推荐配置和预估 Shuffle 收益。有建议时可查看对应的表变更 SQL

GetAutoClusterUtility.description_en: Summarizes the actual benefits of clustering for the current tenant in the current region, including the number of benefited jobs, saved compute unit (CU) hours, and shuffle data volume. Retrieves the benefits for the last day or the cumulative benefits since clustering was applied
GetAutoClusterUtility.description_zh: 汇总当前租户在当前地域的聚簇实际收益，包括受益作业数、节省的 CU 时和 Shuffle 数据量。可查询最近一天或自应用聚簇以来的累计收益

GetAutoClusterUtilityByProject.description_en: Summarizes the actual benefits of automatic clustering for a project, including the number of benefited jobs, saved compute unit (CU) hours, and shuffle data volume. You can filter the results by schema and table
GetAutoClusterUtilityByProject.description_zh: 汇总项目的自动聚簇实际收益，包括受益作业数、节省的 CU 时和 Shuffle 数据量。可按 Schema 和表过滤

GetComputeEffectivePlan.description_en: Retrieves the active compute quota plan
GetComputeEffectivePlan.description_zh: 获取当前生效的计算Quota计划

GetComputeQuotaPlan.description_en: Queries the details of a single compute quota plan
GetComputeQuotaPlan.description_zh: 获取单个计算Quota计划的详细信息

GetComputeQuotaSchedule.description_en: Displays the time-specific configuration of compute quota

GetConversationMessages.description_en: Performs a paging query on the message history of a specified session, including reply content, execution process blocks, and timelines, and optionally refreshes the status of analysis runs
GetConversationMessages.description_zh: 分页查询指定会话的消息历史，包括回复内容、执行过程块与时间线，可选刷新分析运行状态

GetJobInfo.description_en: Queries the basic information of a single job
GetJobInfo.description_zh: 查看单个作业的基础信息

GetJobResourceUsage.description_en: Performs statistics on all jobs that are complete on a specified day and obtains the total resource usage of each job executor on a daily basis
GetJobResourceUsage.description_zh: 指定时间范围内，针对已结束的全部作业进行统计，以“天”为级别展示作业执行者级别的资源使用总量

GetLogviewDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves the download link for the offline Logview file of an instance in a specified MaxCompute project. The link is valid for 10 minutes from the time of generation
GetLogviewDownloadUrl.description_zh: 获取指定 MaxCompute 项目中实例的离线 Logview 文件下载链接，链接自生成起有效期为 10 分钟

GetMmsAsyncTask.description_en: Retrieves a single MMA asynchronous task

GetMmsDataSource.description_en: Retrieves the details of a single MMA data source

GetMmsDb.description_en: Retrieves a database in an MMA data source
GetMmsDb.description_zh: 获取MMA数据源内的某个库

GetMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_en: Retrieves the details of a single MMA metadata retrieval task
GetMmsFetchMetadataJob.description_zh: 获取单个MMA“获取元数据”任务详情

GetMmsJob.description_en: Retrieves the details of a single MMA migration plan
GetMmsJob.description_zh: 获取单个MMA迁移计划详情

GetMmsNetworkBandwidth.description_en: Queries the average bandwidth, per-minute bandwidth details, and effective maximum bandwidth of a specified NetworkLink for the current user within a given time range
GetMmsNetworkBandwidth.description_zh: 查询当前用户指定NetworkLink在给定时间范围内的平均带宽、每分钟带宽明细和有效最大带宽

GetMmsPartition.description_en: Retrieves a partition in an MMA data source
GetMmsPartition.description_zh: 获取MMA数据源内的某个分区

GetMmsTable.description_en: Retrieves a specific table in an MMA data source
GetMmsTable.description_zh: 获取MMA数据源内的某张表

GetMmsTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of a single migration task
GetMmsTask.description_zh: 获取单个迁移任务详情

GetMmsTimer.description_en: Queries the configuration and status of a specified data migration scheduled task
GetMmsTimer.description_zh: 查询指定数据迁移定时任务的配置与状态

GetNetworkLink.description_en: Queries network connectivity in the current tenant by name and returns the connection status, associated VPC, and network configurations of the corresponding type
GetNetworkLink.description_zh: 按名称查询当前租户中的网络连接，返回连接状态、关联 VPC 和对应类型的网络配置

GetPackage.description_en: Obtains the information about a package

GetProgress.description_en: Queries the migration partitions, data volume, and node progress for each data source of the current user in the current region by using paging
GetProgress.description_zh: 分页查询当前用户在当前地域下各数据源的迁移分区、数据量和任务进度

GetProject.description_en: Queries the basic information of a MaxCompute project

GetQuota.description_en: Queries the information of a specified first-level quota group. Note: This API operation will be retired on July 31, 2024. The QueryQuota API operation will be provided as a replacement, with identical request parameters, response elements, and features
GetQuota.description_zh:
获取指定一级Quota组信息。
注意warning: 该接口会在2024年7月31日下线，我们会提供QueryQuota的接口替代，入参，出参，功能完全一样

GetQuotaSchedule.description_en: Obtains the scheduling plan for a quota plan

GetRoleAcl.description_en: Obtains the ACL-based permissions that is granted to a project-level role
GetRoleAcl.description_zh: 获取项目级角色ACL授权信息

GetRoleAclOnObject.description_en: Obtains ACL-based permissions on an object that are granted to a project-level role
GetRoleAclOnObject.description_zh: 获取项目级角色对某对象的ACL授权信息

GetRolePolicy.description_en: Retrieves the policy authorization content of a project-level role
GetRolePolicy.description_zh: 获取项目级角色Policy授权内容

GetRunningJobs.description_en: Obtains the running state data of jobs that are in the running state in a specified period of time
GetRunningJobs.description_zh: 指定时间范围内，所有仍处于“运行中”的作业的运行态数据展示

GetSpeed.description_en: Queries the statistics on the data volume of completed migration tasks for each data source in the current region by day or hour
GetSpeed.description_zh: 按天或按小时查询当前用户在当前地域下各数据源已完成迁移任务的数据量统计

GetStorageSizeSummary.description_en: Retrieves a summary of storage usage

GetStorageSummaryCompared.description_en: Retrieves the year-over-year changes in storage trends
GetStorageSummaryCompared.description_zh: 获取存储趋势同比变化

GetTableInfo.description_en: Queries the details of MaxCompute internal tables, views, external tables, clustered tables, or transactional tables
GetTableInfo.description_zh: 查看MaxCompute内部表、视图、外部表、聚簇表或Transactional表的信息

GetTenantUser.description_en: Queries a user in the current tenant by account ID and returns the account information and associated tenant roles
GetTenantUser.description_zh: 按账号 ID 查询当前租户中的用户，返回账号信息和已关联的租户角色

GetTrustedProjects.description_en: Obtains the trusted projects of the current project
GetTrustedProjects.description_zh: 获取当前项目的TrustedProject（受信任项目）列表

ListArtifacts.description_en: Queries the list of analysis artifacts for the current account with paging, and supports filtering by session and artifact type
ListArtifacts.description_zh: 分页查询当前账号的分析产物列表，支持按会话和产物类型过滤

ListAutoClusterInfo.description_en: Performs a paged query on the tables that have automatic clustering benefit records for the current tenant in the current region, and retrieves the number of benefited jobs, saved compute resources, and shuffle data volume for each table through paging
ListAutoClusterInfo.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户在当前地域有自动聚簇收益记录的表，查看各表的受益作业数、节省的计算量和 Shuffle 数据量

ListAutoClusterInfoByProject.description_en: Performs a paging query for tables that have actual benefit records of auto-clustering in a project and returns the clustering application date and actual benefits. You can filter the results by schema and table, or call GetAutoClusterInfo to view the current clustering configuration of a table
ListAutoClusterInfoByProject.description_zh: 分页查询项目内有自动聚簇实际收益记录的表，返回聚簇应用日期和实际收益。可按 Schema 和表过滤，也可调用 GetAutoClusterInfo 查看表的当前聚簇配置

ListAutoClusterJobInfo.description_en: Queries the actual benefits of auto-clustering for a specified table by using paging. Records are aggregated by job signature and include saved CU hours, shuffle data volume, and job duration
ListAutoClusterJobInfo.description_zh: 分页查询指定表的自动聚簇实际收益。记录按作业签名统计，包含节省的 CU 时、Shuffle 数据量和作业耗时

ListAutoClusterSuggestion.description_en: Performs a paged query on the clustering suggestions for tables of the current tenant in the current region. The paging results show the recommended cluster keys, bucketing count, recommendation score, and estimated data volume of saved shuffle data
ListAutoClusterSuggestion.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户在当前地域各表的聚簇建议，查看推荐的聚簇键、分桶数、推荐指数和预估可节省的 Shuffle 数据量

ListAutoClusterSuggestionByProject.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the auto-clustering recommendations for a project in a specified analysis batch. Returns the recommended configurations, recommendation scores, and estimated shuffle benefits. You can filter the paging results by schema and table
ListAutoClusterSuggestionByProject.description_zh: 分页查询项目在指定分析批次中的自动聚簇建议，返回推荐配置、推荐指数和预估 Shuffle 收益。可按 Schema 和表过滤

ListAutoClusterSuggestionJobInfo.description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the job instances that can benefit from the specified table in the selected analysis batch and the estimated shuffle data volume that can be saved for each instance
ListAutoClusterSuggestionJobInfo.description_zh: 分页查询指定表在所选分析批次中可受益的作业实例及各实例预估可节省的 Shuffle 数据量

ListComputeMetricsByInstance.description_en: Lists job compute usage at the instance level
ListComputeMetricsByInstance.description_zh: 列出instance维度作业计算用量

ListComputeMetricsBySignature.description_en: Queries the details of job compute usage by signature
ListComputeMetricsBySignature.description_zh: 按Signature查看作业计算使用量明细

ListConversations.description_en: Performs a paging query on the agent sessions of the current account and supports filtering by status, agent type, keyword, and session ID
ListConversations.description_zh: 分页查询当前账号的Agent会话列表，支持按状态、Agent类型、关键词和会话ID过滤

ListFunctions.description_en: Obtains functions in a MaxCompute project

ListInstances.description_en: Retrieves the list of instances that require cost analysis for a specific time period
ListInstances.description_zh: 获取需要对某个时间段进行成本分析的实例列表

ListJobMetric.description_en: Retrieves the performance metrics of completed jobs
ListJobMetric.description_zh: 获取运行结束的作业的性能指标

ListJobSnapshotInfos.description_en: Retrieves job snapshot data at a specific point in time
ListJobSnapshotInfos.description_zh: 获取某个时间点的作业快照数据

ListMmsDataSourceConfigItems.description_en: Lists the configuration items for a specified data source type
ListMmsDataSourceConfigItems.description_zh: 列出指定数据源类型的配置项

ListMmsDbs.description_en: Lists the databases in an MMA data source

ListMmsJobs.description_en: Queries the list of migration jobs

ListMmsPartitions.description_en: Lists the partitions in an MMA data source

ListMmsTables.description_en: Lists the tables in a MaxCompute Migration Assist (MMA) data source

ListMmsTaskLogs.description_en: Lists the execution logs for a single migration task
ListMmsTaskLogs.description_zh: 列出单个迁移任务的执行日志

ListMmsTasks.description_en: Retrieves a list of migration tasks

ListMmsTimers.description_zh: 列出数据迁移定时任务

ListNetworkLinks.description_en: Queries the network connectivity of the current tenant in a specified region and returns the connection name, type, status, and associated VPC. To retrieve connection configurations, invoke GetNetworkLink
ListNetworkLinks.description_zh: 查询当前租户在指定地域的网络连接，返回连接名称、类型、状态和关联 VPC。需要连接配置时，调用 GetNetworkLink

ListPackages.description_en: Retrieves the list of packages in a MaxCompute project

ListPeriodicTaskJobs.description_en: 查看周期性任务作业列表
ListPeriodicTaskJobs.description_zh: 查看周期性任务作业列表

ListProjectUsers.description_en: Retrieves the list of users in a project

ListProjects.description_en: Retrieves a list of MaxCompute projects

ListQuotasPlans.description_en: Retrieves the list of quota plans

ListResources.description_en: Retrieves a list of resources in a MaxCompute project
ListResources.description_zh: 获取MaxCompute项目内的资源列表

ListRoles.description_en: Retrieves the list of project-level roles in a MaxCompute project

ListStoragePartitionsInfo.description_en: Retrieves the storage details of each partition in a partitioned table within a specified MaxCompute project
ListStoragePartitionsInfo.description_zh: 获取某个MaxCompute项目内分区表的各分区存储明细

ListStorageProjectsInfo.description_en: Retrieves the storage details of a project

ListStorageTablesInfo.description_en: Retrieves the storage details of tables in a specified MaxCompute project
ListStorageTablesInfo.description_zh: 获取某个MaxCompute项目内的表存储明细

ListTables.description_en: Retrieves a list of tables in a MaxCompute project

ListUsers.description_en: Retrieves all users under a tenant
ListUsers.description_zh: 获取租户下的所有用户列表

ListUsersByRole.description_en: Retrieves the list of users bound to a project-level role
ListUsersByRole.description_zh: 获取绑定某项目级角色的用户列表

QueryDataAnalysisGraph.description_en: Queries the data analytics graph. If the operation parameter is not specified, the full graph is returned based on the data source. If the operation parameter is specified, the corresponding incremental graph operation is performed, such as business domain query, node expansion, search, and data source directory retrieval
QueryDataAnalysisGraph.description_zh: 查询数据分析图谱。不传operation时按数据源返回全量图谱；传入operation时执行对应的增量图谱操作，如业务域查询、节点展开、搜索与数据源目录

QueryQuota.description_en: Queries the information about a specified level-1 quota group

QueryQuotaMetric.description_en: Queries the time-series data of quota resource consumption
QueryQuotaMetric.description_zh: 查看quota资源消耗的时序信息

QueryStorageMetric.description_en: Queries the time series metrics of storage data
QueryStorageMetric.description_zh: 查看存储数据的时序指标

QueryTunnelMetric.description_en: Queries the metric data of the Tunnel data transfer service within a specified time range
QueryTunnelMetric.description_zh: 用于查询指定时间范围内的Tunnel数据传输服务相关指标数据

QueryTunnelMetricDetail.description_en: Queries the detailed data of the Tunnel data transfer service within a specified time range
QueryTunnelMetricDetail.description_zh: 用于查询指定时间范围内的Tunnel数据传输服务相关详情数据

RemoveNetworkLink.description_en: Deletes the network connectivity of the current tenant by name. You can invoke GetNetworkLink to verify the connectivity before deleting it
RemoveNetworkLink.description_zh: 按名称移除当前租户下的网络连接。删除前可调用 GetNetworkLink 核对要操作的连接

RespondAgentAction.description_en: Responds to pending confirmation operations (approvals) or clarification questions generated during an agent run to allow the agent to continue execution
RespondAgentAction.description_zh: 响应Agent运行中产生的待确认操作（审批）或澄清问题，使Agent继续执行

SetTableStorageTier.description_en: Sets the storage tiers for tables or partitions in batches within the same project. Returns the tables or partitions that failed to be processed and the reasons for the failures. Returns an empty list if all operations succeed
SetTableStorageTier.description_zh: 在同一个项目中批量设置表或分区的存储层级。返回处理失败的表或分区及其原因。全部成功时返回空列表

SumBills.description_en: Queries cost information by instance or billable item
SumBills.description_zh: 按实例或者计费项统计费用信息

SumBillsByDate.description_en: Aggregates daily costs by instance or billing item
SumBillsByDate.description_zh: 按实例或者费用项逐日统计费用

SumComputeMetricsByRecord.description_en: Counts the number of usage records

SumComputeMetricsByUsage.description_en: Queries the usage statistics of scan-based computing or CU-hour computing
SumComputeMetricsByUsage.description_zh: 统计扫描量计算类的使用量或者CU时计算类使用量

SumDailyBillsByItem.description_en: Queries the daily billing details by instance or billable item
SumDailyBillsByItem.description_zh: 按实例或者费用项逐日统计费用明细

SumStorageMetricsByDate.description_en: Queries the storage information for each category or project on a specified date
SumStorageMetricsByDate.description_zh: 指定日期查看各个类别的存储信息或各个project的存储信息

SumStorageMetricsByType.description_en: Queries the storage usage by storage type
SumStorageMetricsByType.description_zh: 按存储类型统计存储使用量

TriggerMmsTimer.description_en: Triggers a scheduled data migration task immediately
TriggerMmsTimer.description_zh: 立即触发数据迁移定时任务

UpdateComputeQuotaSchedule.description_en: Updates the time-based plan for a compute quota

UpdateComputeSubQuota.description_en: Updates the basic configurations of MaxCompute, including adding and deleting level-2 quotas, defining the basic attributes of level-2 quotas, and configuring the compute units (CUs) for the currently effective quota plan
UpdateComputeSubQuota.description_zh: 更新MaxCompute的基础配置，包括增加和删除二级Quota，定义二级Quota的基础属性和当前生效的Quota计划的CU配置

UpdateMmsDataSource.description_en: Refetches the metadata of an MMA data source
UpdateMmsDataSource.description_zh: 重新拉取MMA数据源的元数据

UpdateMmsDb.description_en: Updates the destination and status of an MMS database

UpdatePackage.description_en: Updates the objects in a package and projects in which the package can be installed
UpdatePackage.description_zh: 更新Package内的对象及允许安装的项目列表

UpdateProjectBasicMeta.description_en: Modifies the basic information of a project

UpdateProjectDefaultQuota.description_en: Updates the default computing quota of a project

UpdateProjectIpWhiteList.description_en: Updates the IP address whitelist for a MaxCompute project

UpdateProjectModelTier.description_en: Upgrades the two-level model of a project to a three-level model
UpdateProjectModelTier.description_zh: 将project的二层模型升级为三层模型

UpdateTenantUserRoles.description_en: Grants or revokes specified tenant roles for a user in the current tenant based on the account ID. The request parameters list the roles to be granted and revoked separately. If an eligible account has not joined the tenant, the operation adds the user first
UpdateTenantUserRoles.description_zh: 按账号 ID 为当前租户中的用户授予或撤销指定租户角色。入参分别列出待授予和待撤销的角色。符合条件的账号尚未加入租户时，接口会先添加用户

UpdateUsersToRole.description_en: Adds or removes users from a project role
UpdateUsersToRole.description_zh: 项目角色添加或删除用户
